sources.entry: ⭐️ Testing strategies in a microservices architecture (Martin Fowler) is an awesome resources explaining how to test a service properly.

summary.title: Testing Strategies in a Microservice Architecture
summary.one_liner: Microservices add network boundaries that change how you test, so you need to rethink which kinds of tests to write and how to mix them.
takeaways: Splitting a system into microservices adds network partitions, so testing strategies designed for monolithic in-process applications need rethinking.
The page is a slide deck by Martin Fowler (18 November 2014) that outlines the kinds of tests needed for microservices and how to mix them.
summary.summary: This is a slide deck by Martin Fowler, published 18 November 2014, on testing strategies for microservice architectures. It starts from the motivation: independently deployable and scalable services introduce network partitions, which break the assumptions of testing monolithic in-process applications. The deck outlines the kinds of tests a microservice system needs and how to combine them. The fetched page text is mostly navigation instructions for the slide viewer, so the specific test types and details are not visible here.
